purpose: Improve localization and displacement readout, not compare model generations.
reader_selection: Known-translation development tests only; lock candidate before measuring the real 120-pair outcome.
independent_check: Held-out synthetic phases/noise plus known translations of real-image crops; report limitations of simulated translations.
primary_selection_metric: Balanced known-translation vector error in native pixels across both radii; reject failures, biased responses and unsupported convergence.
real_report: Original horizontal-step definition and three separate statistics, all pairs retained. Independent nine-pillar displacements retained before aggregation.
aggregation: Preserve median as primary; arithmetic mean may be reported as a predeclared sensitivity, never force nine displacements to the same value.
not_allowed: selecting methods or tuning parameters to minimize nominal-step errors on the 120 pairs
claiming a new reader follows the unchanged submitted backend
claiming lower nominal error proves absolute accuracy
